setup.installB24Intro: This app can be registered as a Bitrix24 placement — the converter button then appears right in the panel above the chat input.
setup.installB24Step1: In your portal, open Developer resources → Other → Local application.
setup.installB24Step5: Press Save, then Install — the install page registers the chat-panel widget for you.
setup.selfHostIntro: Want your own domain or air-gapped install? The repository is MIT-licensed and ships with two ready deploy targets.
setup.selfHostOption1: GitHub Pages — one-click via the bundled GitHub Actions workflow.
setup.selfHostOption2: Docker — multi-stage image in GHCR + docker compose on your server (nginx + SPA fallback).
